resources.name: Realtime Colors

source.maintenance: The hosted tool is current; its public source repository states that it is no longer updated.
source.license: Color selections are user decisions. Every chosen font requires independent license verification. The published website source is CC BY-NC-ND and must not be copied or modified.

resources.trigger: Color roles or typography remain open and a person would benefit from comparing them on a realistic generic page before product-specific previews are built.
prerequisites: Capture the product, audience, desired feeling, existing-brand constraints, and colors to avoid.
Use only non-confidential inputs in the external website.
Treat its contrast indicators as exploration, not final WCAG evidence.
bring_back: Chosen light and dark color roles for canvas, surface, text, primary, secondary, accent, focus, and status.
Heading and body font candidates, type scale, and licensing constraints.
A share URL or screenshot as provenance plus accepted and rejected alternatives.
Product-specific preview and independent contrast evidence before approval.
return_to: docs/20-design/DESIGN_BRIEF.md for accepted and rejected color/type decisions and font-license findings.
.agentic/design-directions.json for product-specific candidate token roles after exploration.
docs/50-evals/ for screenshots and independent contrast evidence.
forbidden: Copying, vendoring, or modifying Realtime Colors website source or branded materials.
Treating its five generic roles as the final semantic token model.
Writing exported raw values directly into product components.
Claiming palette exploration is a product-specific design direction.

resources.name: Haikei

source.maintenance: Official hosted generator with SVG and PNG export; no official source repository is claimed.
source.license: Official pricing guidance permits personal and professional use of generated designs, with limitations on using them to provide a similar generator service.

resources.trigger: A candidate asset strategy calls for an original abstract SVG or raster background, texture, pattern, wave, blob, gradient, or geometric scene.
prerequisites: Name the product-specific role of the asset and why a plain surface, CSS, data visualization, illustration, or owned media is insufficient.
Choose colors from the candidate token direction rather than inventing a parallel palette.
Use only non-confidential inputs in the external website.
bring_back: The exported project-local SVG or PNG plus generator type, dimensions, parameters, date, and canonical source URL.
Token-role mapping, placement rules, responsive crop or scaling behavior, and dark-mode treatment.
Optimized-file evidence, accessible alternative or decorative semantics, and visual/performance review.
return_to: .agentic/design-assets.json for the validated generator, parameters, file, token, responsive, theme, semantics, license, and evidence record.
.agentic/design-directions.json for the candidate asset role and considered alternatives.
docs/50-evals/ for running-product visual, accessibility, and performance evidence.
forbidden: Automatic browser interaction, download, or project write.
Generic blob, wave, or gradient decoration without a product-specific role.
Unreviewed inline SVG, inaccessible meaningful imagery, or assets that bypass approved tokens.
Using generated output to provide a competing design-generator service.

resources.name: Motion Primitives

source.maintenance: Actively maintained and explicitly described upstream as beta.

resources.trigger: A web interaction has an approved motion purpose and a reviewed component can communicate it more clearly than a small local CSS or platform-native transition.
prerequisites: Approve the design direction and record motion purpose, interruption or reversal behavior, performance budget, and reduced-motion behavior.
Confirm web platform compatibility and inspect the exact component source and dependencies.
Prefer the least expensive implementation that communicates the change.
bring_back: Exact selected component and immutable source revision with a reviewed local diff.
Mapping to project semantic tokens and component contracts rather than upstream styling.
Keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, interruption, responsive, and performance evidence from the running product.
Attribution and license records required by project policy.
return_to: .agentic/design-directions.json for motion purpose, interruption/reversal, performance budget, and reduced-motion behavior.
docs/50-evals/ for running-product interaction, accessibility, responsive, reduced-motion, and performance evidence.
forbidden: Automatic installation, CLI execution, copying, or dependency changes.
Invoking an entire library or preserving its visual identity by default.
Decorative motion without a user or system-state purpose.
Using a web component route as native-mobile implementation guidance.
